summary: Computer Engineering graduate from York University (2025) and full-stack developer. Builds and ships web applications in TypeScript, Next.js, React, and PostgreSQL. Current project FootPal FC: {models}-model Postgres schema, {handlers} HTTP handlers, {testBlocks} test blocks, in use by 25+ players.

experience.title: Co-Founder & Frontend Developer
bullets: Built an in-app unsaved-changes guard for the card editor: capture-phase anchor interception, patched History API methods, and popstate handling all routed through a styled modal, with consume-once escape hatches so programmatic navigation bypasses the prompt.

Traced misplaced and vanishing QR codes to NaN reaching SVG transforms from card records persisted before the geometry fields existed, then guarded every term with finite-value checks and added a centering fallback on the card-creation path.

Replaced the inherited onboarding flow with a five-step in-house tour, fixing the z-index stacking that left highlighted controls unclickable by raising targets above the overlay and dropping the mobile action bar beneath it.

Shipped CSV export, card sharing, and Open Graph metadata so shared card links render proper previews, plus a shared plan renewal/expiry utility used by the settings, billing, and company settings pages.
Built earlier iterations of the page editor and card designer — the surfaces users composed and styled their cards in — prior to the frontend rebuild in early 2026.
